commands.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('apps/mobile/src/__tests__/hardware-setup.test.tsx')
s=p.read_text()
old="""    fireEvent.click(
      within(await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Usunąć termometr?' })).getByRole(
        'button',
        { name: 'Usuń' }
      )
    );"""
new="""    fireEvent.click(
      getIonicButton(
        await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Usunąć termometr?' }),
        'Usuń'
      )
    );"""
assert s.count(old)==1
assert 'getIonicButton,' in s
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
PY
pnpm exec prettier --write apps/mobile/src/__tests__/hardware-setup.test.tsx
git diff --check
echo 'HARDWARE_SETUP_INTEGRATION_SUITE'
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec vitest run src/__tests__/hardware-setup.test.tsx --reporter=default
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile typecheck
pnpm quality:ux
git add apps/mobile/src/__tests__/hardware-setup.test.tsx
git commit -m "test(ionic): exercise thermometer removal through Ionic host"
git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/work/ux-evolution
echo "INTEGRATION_FIX_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
git status --short
